notes: Useful-time default 100% (user request, 26 Nov 23:45): when a box is completed its useful time defaults to 100% of its actual time unless the user changes it — stopping a timer records the just-stopped session at 100% (no prompt any more, so a stopped box is never left «ثبت نشده» and the I-7 topbar chip stays hidden) and ticking a box done with real time recorded and no useful yet records useful = real in full. An explicit useful value is never overwritten, boxes with no real time stay «ثبت نشده», and already-completed boxes are not backfilled. The prompt UI stays for a pending prompt loaded from an older state, with 100% marked as its default chip. No code-quality items (D/DC/MQ/NM) — those are v1.11.54.
